description: This file provides functions for handling extended attributes (xattr) on BSD systems (FreeBSD and NetBSD), including getting, setting, removing, and listing extended attributes via system calls.

methods.name: xattrnamespace
methods.description: Derives the namespace and attribute name from a full attribute string, returning namespace constants and attribute name.

methods.name: initxattrdest
methods.description: Initializes a destination pointer for extended attribute data, handling nil and zero-length cases.

methods.name: Getxattr
methods.description: Retrieves extended attribute data for a file.

methods.name: Fgetxattr
methods.description: Retrieves extended attribute data for a file descriptor.

methods.name: Lgetxattr
methods.description: Retrieves extended attribute data for a symbolic link.

methods.name: Fsetxattr
methods.description: Sets extended attribute data for a file descriptor.

methods.name: Setxattr
methods.description: Sets extended attribute data for a file.

methods.name: Lsetxattr
methods.description: Sets extended attribute data for a symbolic link.

methods.name: Removexattr
methods.description: Removes an extended attribute from a file.

methods.name: Fremovexattr
methods.description: Removes an extended attribute from a file descriptor.

methods.name: Lremovexattr
methods.description: Removes an extended attribute from a symbolic link.

methods.name: Listxattr
methods.description: Lists extended attributes of a file.

methods.name: Flistxattr
methods.description: Lists extended attributes of a file descriptor.

methods.name: Llistxattr
methods.description: Lists extended attributes of a symbolic link.
